# Stretchy Header

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

Use visualEffect to read the header’s position in scroll-view coordinates. Scale from its bottom edge only during positive overscroll, filling the gap without offset state or resizing the layout below. Keep the header still with Reduce Motion.

- Before: Pull-down exposes a gap
- After: Header stretches into the gap

APIs: `visualEffect`, `GeometryProxy`, `scrollView`, `scaleEffect`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Pull down at the top; on Mac, use a trackpad to overscroll.
struct StretchyHeaderDoExample: View {
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 6) {
            Text("Pull down at the top").font(.caption)
            ScrollView {
                VStack(spacing: 0) {
                    LinearGradient(colors: [.cyan, .blue, .indigo],
                                   startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                        .overlay {
                            Image(systemName: "mountain.2.fill")
                                .font(.system(size: 52))
                                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                        }
                        .frame(height: 100)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    // excerpt:start
                    .visualEffect { content, geometry in
                        let height = max(geometry.size.height, 1)
                        let pull = max(0, geometry.frame(in: .scrollView).minY)
                        let scale = reduceMotion ? 1 : (height + pull) / height
                        return content.scaleEffect(x: scale, y: scale, anchor: .bottom)
                    }
                    // excerpt:end
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                        Text("Mountain trail").font(.headline)
                        Text("A quiet route above the valley.")
                        Text("Distance: 4 km")
                        Text("Elevation: 280 m")
                    }
                    .font(.caption)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .padding(12)
                }
            }
            .scrollBounceBehavior(.always)
        }
    }
}
```
